play.definition: A post-snap option concept that combines a called run with one or more attached quick-pass routes. The quarterback receives the snap, establishes a mesh with the running back, reads a designated conflict defender, and either completes the handoff or pulls the ball and throws immediately to an attached receiver. The offensive line executes the called run-blocking scheme on both branches while the run and pass elements develop simultaneously.

Action_None.label: None
Action_None.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

Action_RunAfterCatch.label: Run After Catch
Action_RunAfterCatch.definition: A receiver's action of advancing the football after completing a catch, using acceleration, cuts, and open-field movement to gain additional yardage.

Action_SecureCatch.label: Secure Catch
Action_SecureCatch.definition: A receiver's action of establishing clear possession and control of a forward, lateral, or backward pass after the football reaches the hands or body.

Action_SnapReceive.label: Snap Receive
Action_SnapReceive.definition: The action of the quarterback securing the ball from the center’s snap to initiate the play.

Action_ThrowScreenPass.label: Throw Screen Pass
Action_ThrowScreenPass.definition: A quarterback's or other passer's action of delivering a short forward or lateral pass to an eligible receiver positioned near or behind blockers for a designed screen play.

Action_TurnToQuarterback.label: Turn To Quarterback
Action_TurnToQuarterback.definition: A receiver's action of rotating the head, shoulders, hips, or entire body toward the quarterback to locate the ball and present a receiving target.
